feats.name: Skilled
feats.description: Gain Proficiency in one skill of your choice.

feats.name: Adaptable
feats.description: Once per long rest, after drawing cards for a skill check, you may discard one card and draw a replacement card.

feats.name: Determined
feats.description: Once per short rest, when you fail a skill check, you may burn one card to attempt the check again.

feats.name: Spell Weaver
feats.description: Learn one Tier 1 spell of your choice that your character is otherwise capable of learning or casting.

feats.name: Elven Grace
feats.description: Gain Proficiency in Acrobatics or Stealth.

feats.name: Keen Senses
feats.description: Gain Proficiency in Perception or Investigation.

feats.name: Stonewise
feats.description: Gain Proficiency in History or Investigation. When examining stonework, masonry, tunnels, or underground structures, you may ask the GM one additional useful question.

feats.name: Iron Stomach
feats.description: You have advantage when resisting mundane poison, spoiled food, or similar harmful substances.

feats.name: Lucky
feats.description: When you draw an Ace, you may redraw it. The redrawn card replaces the Ace for resolving the action or check. If you keep the Ace, it follows the normal Ace and Gobble rules.

feats.name: Cheerful
feats.description: When you use Rallying Cry, the ally receiving the benefit draws one additional card.

feats.name: Nimble
feats.description: Gain Proficiency in Acrobatics or Stealth.

feats.name: Friendly Face
feats.description: Gain Proficiency in Persuasion or Insight.
